IGUI_XPR_ModOptions_AttachHudName: Attach XP HUD to Radial Menu
IGUI_XPR_ModOptions_AttachHudDesc: When Enabled, the XP Ranks HUD only shows while the Radial Menu is open. When Disabled, it's always visible. Default: Disabled
IGUI_XPR_ModOptions_EnableSoundsDesc: Enables XP Ranks Notifications and XP Ticker Feed sounds. Default: Enabled
IGUI_XPR_ModOptions_TickerAlignmentDesc: Changes the horizontal alignment of XP Ticker Feed. Default: Right
IGUI_XPR_Sidebar_ScaleTooltip: Change the size of the XP Ranks Icon
IGUI_XPR_LeaderboardExclude_Instruction: Choose a Category (or All Leaderboards) and select an entry to include or exclude. Rank and XP are not changed.
IGUI_XPR_LeaderboardExclude_Confirm: Exclude the selected entry from this Leaderboard Category?
IGUI_XPR_LeaderboardInclude_Confirm: Include the selected entry in this Leaderboard Category?
IGUI_XPR_LeaderboardExclude_ConfirmAll: Exclude the selected entry from EVERY Leaderboard Category?
IGUI_XPR_LeaderboardInclude_ConfirmAll: Restore the selected entry to all Leaderboard Categories (per-category exclusions still apply)?
IGUI_XPR_AdminMenu_ConfirmBackup: Create a Backup of current XP Ranks Data?
IGUI_XPR_Settings_GrantRewardBoxesToolti: When Off, Rank levels no longer grant Reward Boxes. Rank/XP itself is unaffected.
IGUI_XPR_Settings_IntervalTooltip: Every multiple of this Rank grants a Reward Box. (Default: 5)
IGUI_XPR_Settings_CurveTooltip: Base XP: Amount of XP needed for Rank 1 to 2. Step: Extra XP added per Rank climbed after that.
IGUI_XPR_Settings_TiersTooltip: Adjust Rank ranges and Reward Rarity weights
IGUI_XPR_Settings_PvpKillXpTooltip: Award XP for killing other Players (Multiplayer only). Also requires the server's PVP option to be enabled.
IGUI_XPR_Settings_ResetRankOnDeathToolti: Wipe a Player's Rank, XP, and Leaderboard progress when their Character dies. (Default: OFF)
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_DontShowAgain: Hide Patch Notes UI until Next Update
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v104_01: - Fixed a Bug causing Reward Boxes on Dedicated Servers to roll a small selection of Items instead of the full Reward Pool.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v104_02: - Servers with PVP Enabled can now allow Players to gain Rank XP from Player Kills. Requires 'PVP Kill XP' Setting to be Enabled. Amount of XP awarded and Per-Victim Cooldown can be configured in the 'Activity XP Yield' window.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v104_03: - Enabling 'PVP Kill XP' adds a new 'Player Kills' tab to the Leaderboard.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v104_04: - Server Admins can now Enable/Disable whether XP Rank is reset to 1 on Player Death (Default: Off).
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v104_05: - Players outside of the Top 10 in any Leaderboard Category will now see their respective position at the bottom of the Leaderboard Panel (This was previously only in the Overall category).
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v101_01: - Fixed a Bug resulting in a Sidebar Icon conflict with Companion Dogs (and likely other Mods that add Sidebar Icons with the same logic).
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v102_01: - Fixed a Bug resulting in a Sidebar Icon conflict with Mods that use ISEquippedItem:initialise() for their Icons (A different method to what Companion Dogs uses). In the case that a further unforeseen Sidebar Icon conflict occurs, setting this Mod's Icon to Draggable should no longer prevent Users from clicking/opening the other Mod's Sidebar Icon.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v103_01: - Fixed a bug preventing changes to the Reward Items from saving correctly.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v103_02: - Fixed a bug causing the XP Ticker Feed icon to not display in non-English languages.
IGUI_XPR_BackupPicker_LoadConfirm: This will replace current Rank/XP, Reward Items, and Settings Data with the selected Backup. Continue?
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_SetRankInstr: Search and select one or more Players/Characters, enter a Target Rank, then Set Rank. Also grants the amount of XP they would need to achieve that Rank. XP is only added to the 'Overall' Category.
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_SetRankConfirm: Set Rank for %1 selected Player(s)/Character(s)? Their Category XP is not affected. This cannot be undone.
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_AddXpInstr: Search and select one or more Players/Characters, enter an XP amount (Maximum: %1), then Add XP. Offline Players/Characters who cross a Reward Box Interval will receive their Reward Box on their next Login.
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_AddXpConfirm: Add this XP amount to %1 selected Player(s)/Character(s)?
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_AddRewardBoxInstr: Search and select one Player/Character, enter a Reward Box Rank (1-%1), then Add Reward Box. Offline Players/Characters receive the box on their next Login.
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_AddRewardBoxConfir: Add a Reward Box to the selected Player/Character?
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_ResetInstr: Search and select one or more Players/Characters, then Reset Rank to wipe them to Rank 1 / 0 XP and clear every Category. This removes them from all Leaderboards.
IGUI_XPR_PlayerPicker_ResetConfirm: Wipe %1 selected Player(s)/Character(s) to Rank 1 / 0 XP and clear all their Category XP? Removes them from every Leaderboard. Cannot be undone.
IGUI_XPR_Toast_DebugRewardBoxQueued: Queued %1 for %2. It will be delivered on their next Login.
IGUI_XPR_Toast_DebugRewardBoxInvalidRank: Debug Reward Box action rejected: invalid Rank.
IGUI_XPR_Toast_DebugRewardBoxInvalidTarg: Debug Reward Box action rejected: invalid target.
IGUI_XPR_Toast_DebugRewardBoxTargetUnava: Debug Reward Box action rejected: target unavailable.
IGUI_XPR_Toast_DebugRewardBoxMalformed: Debug Reward Box action rejected: malformed request.
IGUI_XPR_Toast_DebugRewardBoxDeliveryFai: Debug Reward Box action failed: delivery failed.

IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v106_01: - Fixed a Bug resulting in the Sidebar Icon duplicating upon Player death.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_01: - Updated Sidebar Logic to prevent the Mod showing with [ERRORS] in the Pause Menu (Multiplayer).
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_02: - Added Support for the following Mods. Each has its own adjustable XP Yield (see below) and appears in the Leaderboard under its mapped Category:
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_05: - Awards Rank XP for every Timed Action. Ticker Feed displays Efficiency XP bundled in multiples of 5 (Do 5x Timed Actions to see 'Efficiency +5 XP')
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_06: Combat Mastering Skill (Workshop ID: 3435985650) -> Combat - Melee
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_08: - Awards Rank XP for every Melee Combat hit. Ticker Feed displays Combat Mastering XP bundled in multiples of 5 (Do 3x Melee hits to see 'Combat Mastering +5 XP')
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_11: - Awards Rank XP for every Zombie Kill. Ticker Feed displays Toughness XP bundled in multiples of 5 (Do 2x Zombie Kill within 3 seconds to see 'Toughness +10 XP')
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_12: Each Mod's XP Yield can be edited via the 'Activity XP Yield' option in XPR Settings (Admin Menu). Each Section is only visible when its respective Mod is installed.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_13: - Added dynamic width sizing to the XPR Settings Window.
IGUI_XPR_PatchNotes_v105_15: - Updated RU Translation files. Translator: V1rt
